The seven Sol Tower rise frames in sol_tower_animation_tbl order (xevious_main.68k 3068-3078): 1x1 codes 0xA8, 0xA9, 0xAA, 0xAB, then 2x2 codes 0xAE, 0xB2, 0xB6 each in a 32x32 cell laid from its top-left as the arcade lays the sprite from its position, the 2x2 frames as sprite_draw_double_width_and_height draws them (amiga.68k 2529-2544: low two code bits masked, codes base+0..+3 at the 16-px sub-cells), decoded at sprite CLUT 7 (pulsing_colour_1's first value; the pulse only changes CLUT entry 7, which no Sol Tower pixel uses). The Spriters Resource crops showed only the dome, without the tower's shadow, so the frames are taken from the pinned reference the build already grounds on (as the andor_genesis and bonus_flag sheets are).

5559843ea7aebd99883f288c657142ec.png.source: Pinned arcade reference jotd666/xevious @71473685a8c7856c8401c8519276cd97a38d4183, assets/amiga/xevious_gfx.c, rendered by tools/effects_sprite_render.py. Row 1: the player explosion (solvalou_explosion_tbl, xevious_main.68k 2093-2100: C0, C1, C4 2x2, C8 2x2, C2, C3, CC 2x2, step n at colour 0x30+n). Row 2: the air explosion (flying_obj_explosion_sprites 4892-4897: 70, 71, 74/78/7C 2x2, colour 7). Row 3: the ground explosion (bomb_explosion_animation_tbl 4944-4951: 60, 61, 64/68/6C 2x2, 62, 63, colour 0x0C). Explosion cells are 32x32 with every frame centred: each explosion nudges the object 8 px up-left as it enters a 2x2 frame (player 2056-2063, air 4872-4875, ground 4919-4923), which cancels half of the 2x2's right/down overhang (sprite_draw_double_width_and_height, amiga.68k 2529-2544), so a 1x1 frame sits centred and a 2x2 frame fills the cell. Row 4, 16x16 cells: the crater A6/A7 at colour 0x0D (bomb_explosion_finished 4931-4942), the bank-1 crosshair tile 0x114 at colours 32/33/41/42 (handle_crosshairs 2239-2281) and the bomb target (same tile, colour 0x22, init_bombing 2469). Row 5: the bank-1 bomb tiles 0x11C/0x11D/0x11E at colours 0x25-0x28 (2468-2488); the enemy bullet is tile 0x11E at those colours (4763; xevious_sub.68k 208-218) and reuses the last four cells. A colour-table entry of 0x80 draws nothing.

15db3612ae50af18a98fb6ae1d04ced1.png.source: Pinned arcade reference jotd666/xevious @71473685a8c7856c8401c8519276cd97a38d4183, assets/amiga/xevious_gfx.c, rendered by tools/reference_art_render.py; bank-1 tiles (amiga.68k 1883-1886). Row 1: the Giddo Spario flight, codes 0x100-0x103 at colours 0x26-0x29, code-major (handle_08_Giddo_Spario, xevious_main.68k 5219-5239). Row 2: its hit, codes 0x104-0x107 at the same four colours (giddo_spario_hit 5241-5252 keeps the colour). Row 3: the bodies at the pulsing colour (xevious_sub.68k 208-232: 0x10-0x14): the Zakato 0x111 once (it draws the same at every pulsing colour, 3749), the Brag Zakato 0x112 at 0x10-0x13 (3877, 3903; its 0x14 is the Zakato picture) and the Garu Zakato 0x113 at 0x10-0x14 (4014). Row 4: the Zakato self-destruct, codes 0x104-0x108 drawn 1x1 at the five pulsing colours, code-major (zakato_exploding_sprite_tbl 3953-3959; zakato_explode 3931-3950 never stores the size bits). Row 5: the Brag Spario 0x115 at colour 0x26 (handle_09_Brag_Spario 3080-3121), the player's shot 0x116/0x117 at colours 0x23/0x24 (2374-2388) and its Bacura rebound 0x118-0x11B at 0x23 (shot_destroyed 2400-2417). Row 6: the title sparkle 0x130-0x13F at colour 0x0F (attract_mode_title_screen 1217-1290: 0x130-0x137 a code every 2 frames as it appears and disappears, 0x138-0x13F a code every frame while it moves, 1255-1258). Row 7, 32x32 cells, every frame centred: the Zakato teleport sparkle at colour 0x24 (zakato_teleport_sprite_tbl 3986-3992: 0x10C and 0x108 at 2x2, then 0x107, 0x106, 0x105); flip-expanded as a whole, as the Neo Geo renderer flips a 2x2 (neogeo.68k 952-961) from the flip bits the game stores (3978-3981), which the Amiga renderer drops on a 2x2 (amiga.68k 2530). Cut unflipped and x-flipped only: the flip bits are TIMER & 3 (3978-3981) and the build's slot timer steps 2 frames a tick, so only the even values (none, x) are drawn. Then, in 16x16 cells after the sparkle, the self-destruct 0x104-0x108 at the teleport colour 0x24: a Zakato that fires on its first live frame never wrote the pulsing colour (the fire test precedes the colour write, 3755-3757) and keeps init_teleport's 0x24 (4002). A colour-table entry of 0x80 draws nothing.

Row 3: the bodies at the pulsing colour (xevious_sub.68k 208-232: 0x10-0x14): the Zakato 0x111 once (it draws the same at every pulsing colour, 3749), the Brag Zakato 0x112 at 0x10-0x13 (3877, 3903; its 0x14 is the Zakato picture) and the Garu Zakato 0x113 at 0x10-0x14 (4014). Row 4: the Zakato self-destruct, codes 0x104-0x108 drawn 1x1 at the five pulsing colours, code-major (zakato_exploding_sprite_tbl 3953-3959; zakato_explode 3931-3950 never stores the size bits). Row 5: the Brag Spario 0x115 at colour 0x26 (handle_09_Brag_Spario 3080-3121), the player's shot 0x116/0x117 at colours 0x23/0x24 (2374-2388) and its Bacura rebound 0x118-0x11B at 0x23 (shot_destroyed 2400-2417). Row 2: its hit, codes 0x104-0x107 at the same four colours (giddo_spario_hit 5241-5252 keeps the colour). Row 3: the bodies at the pulsing colour (xevious_sub.68k 208-232: 0x10-0x14): the Zakato 0x111 once (it draws the same at every pulsing colour, 3749), the Brag Zakato 0x112 at 0x10-0x13 (3877, 3903; its 0x14 is the Zakato picture) and the Garu Zakato 0x113 at 0x10-0x14 (4014). Row 4: the Zakato self-destruct, codes 0x104-0x108 drawn 1x1 at the five pulsing colours, code-major (zakato_exploding_sprite_tbl 3953-3959; zakato_explode 3931-3950 never stores the size bits). Row 5: the Brag Spario 0x115 at colour 0x26 (handle_09_Brag_Spario 3080-3121), the player's shot 0x116/0x117 at colours 0x23/0x24 (2374-2388) and its Bacura rebound 0x118-0x11B at 0x23 (shot_destroyed 2400-2417). Row 6: the title sparkle 0x130-0x13F at colour 0x0F (attract_mode_title_screen 1217-1290: 0x130-0x137 a code every 2 frames as it appears and disappears, 0x138-0x13F a code every frame while it moves, 1255-1258). Then, in 16x16 cells after the sparkle, the self-destruct 0x104-0x108 at the teleport colour 0x24: a Zakato that fires on its first live frame never wrote the pulsing colour (the fire test precedes the colour write, 3755-3757) and keeps init_teleport's 0x24 (4002). Row 3: the bodies at the pulsing colour (xevious_sub.68k 208-232: 0x10-0x14): the Zakato 0x111 once (it draws the same at every pulsing colour, 3749), the Brag Zakato 0x112 at 0x10-0x13 (3877, 3903; its 0x14 is the Zakato picture) and the Garu Zakato 0x113 at 0x10-0x14 (4014). Row 4: the Zakato self-destruct, codes 0x104-0x108 drawn 1x1 at the five pulsing colours, code-major (zakato_exploding_sprite_tbl 3953-3959; zakato_explode 3931-3950 never stores the size bits). Row 5: the Brag Spario 0x115 at colour 0x26 (handle_09_Brag_Spario 3080-3121), the player's shot 0x116/0x117 at colours 0x23/0x24 (2374-2388) and its Bacura rebound 0x118-0x11B at 0x23 (shot_destroyed 2400-2417). Row 6: the title sparkle 0x130-0x13F at colour 0x0F (attract_mode_title_screen 1217-1290: 0x130-0x137 a code every 2 frames as it appears and disappears, 0x138-0x13F a code every frame while it moves, 1255-1258). Row 2: its hit, codes 0x104-0x107 at the same four colours (giddo_spario_hit 5241-5252 keeps the colour). Row 3: the bodies at the pulsing colour (xevious_sub.68k 208-232: 0x10-0x14): the Zakato 0x111 once (it draws the same at every pulsing colour, 3749), the Brag Zakato 0x112 at 0x10-0x13 (3877, 3903; its 0x14 is the Zakato picture) and the Garu Zakato 0x113 at 0x10-0x14 (4014). Row 4: the Zakato self-destruct, codes 0x104-0x108 drawn 1x1 at the five pulsing colours, code-major (zakato_exploding_sprite_tbl 3953-3959; zakato_explode 3931-3950 never stores the size bits). Row 5: the Brag Spario 0x115 at colour 0x26 (handle_09_Brag_Spario 3080-3121), the player's shot 0x116/0x117 at colours 0x23/0x24 (2374-2388) and its Bacura rebound 0x118-0x11B at 0x23 (shot_destroyed 2400-2417). Row 6: the title sparkle 0x130-0x13F at colour 0x0F (attract_mode_title_screen 1217-1290: 0x130-0x137 a code every 2 frames as it appears and disappears, 0x138-0x13F a code every frame while it moves, 1255-1258). Row 7, 32x32 cells, every frame centred: the Zakato teleport sparkle at colour 0x24 (zakato_teleport_sprite_tbl 3986-3992: 0x10C and 0x108 at 2x2, then 0x107, 0x106, 0x105); flip-expanded as a whole, as the Neo Geo renderer flips a 2x2 (neogeo.68k 952-961) from the flip bits the game stores (3978-3981), which the Amiga renderer drops on a 2x2 (amiga.68k 2530). Cut unflipped and x-flipped only: the flip bits are TIMER & 3 (3978-3981) and the build's slot timer steps 2 frames a tick, so only the even values (none, x) are drawn. Then, in 16x16 cells after the sparkle, the self-destruct 0x104-0x108 at the teleport colour 0x24: a Zakato that fires on its first live frame never wrote the pulsing colour (the fire test precedes the colour write, 3755-3757) and keeps init_teleport's 0x24 (4002). A colour-table entry of 0x80 draws nothing.
